item.title: Delhi’s pollution crisis is alarming: Here is how we can fix it at a personal and govt level
item.description: The problem of pollution and its causes are crystal clear. A report by IIT Delhi (Centre of Excellence for Research on Clean Air (CERCA), IIT Delhi) says that 53% of the problem is polluting vehicle emissions.

item.title: Punch and the viral misunderstanding: How monkey social behaviour explains the heartbreaking video
item.description: The widely shared footage shows Punch being dragged after approaching another baby monkey. Experts and zoo authorities stress that such corrective behaviour is essential for orphaned macaques to understand boundaries, hierarchy, and communication within their group.
